fieldData.awb---key-feature-1-content:
The sheet is filed before the van leaves

Ben Walsh photographs his inspection sheet for unit HV-2207 at the end of a service call. The app reads 11 fields into job JOB-4471 and checks the serial against the customer's equipment list. Ten fields save on their own. The suction pressure is smudged, and it goes to Hannah Cole in the office with the photo attached.

awb---key-feature-1-image.alt: A photographed handwritten inspection sheet is read into 11 fields of a service job, and the one smudged pressure reading is sent to the office coordinator with the photo attached.

acrm---key-feature-3-image.alt: A business card scanned at a trade show booth is matched to an existing CRM contact by email, and a booth note is added to her record instead of creating a duplicate.

acrm---key-feature-4-image.alt: A signed customer setup form is written once to HubSpot and the help desk, while the QuickBooks customer is held because the tax ID has 8 digits and finance gets a direct message to fix it.

thumbnail-image.alt: Build data entry automation that ends the retyping, with Emergent
